1  2  JUDGMENT

The respondents herein were prosecuted for the offence under Section 16(1) (a) (i), (ii) r/w 7(i) 2(ia)
(a) and (m) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
The prosecution ended in acquittal.
Challenging the same, this Criminal Appeal has been filed by the Food Inspector, Pudukottai Municipal Corporation, Pudukottai.

2. Heard the learned counsel on either side.
3.
It is seen that there was no compliance of the requirement as per the provisions of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
The sample of the adulterated food item will have to be given to the accused within the stipulated time.
It was not done.
Therefore, the Court below rightly acquitted the accused.
http://www.judis.nic.in
4. I find no ground to interfere with the Judgment passed by the Court below.
The Criminal Appeal stands dismissed.
No costs.
